note: Thresholds are placeholders (null) until the thesis author sets them. Ids are stable and referenced from THESIS.md. supports_if says on which side of the threshold the signing/settlement-layer thesis is supported; it is null until a threshold is set.

signals.label: v1.signer activity versus its peak
signals.metric: signer_txs 30-day average divided by its peak 30-day average (peak 2026-05-16)
signals.note: Threshold pending. Counts every transaction touching v1.signer, including MPC node respond calls (about half of the sampled hour).

signals.label: Breadth of signing callers
signals.metric: median distinct sign callers per sampled hour, last 30 days of samples
signals.note: Threshold pending. Lower bound per hour from the 12:00-12:59 UTC sample; do not scale to per-day counts.

signals.label: Bridge and connector share of sign calls
signals.metric: share of sign calls whose caller is omni.bridge.near, any *.bridge.near or any *connector* account, last 30 days of samples (fast-auth.near share shown for contrast)
signals.note: Threshold pending. A rising bridge share would mean signing is driven by cross-chain infrastructure rather than NEAR-native fast-auth.
